propositions: Production rich-text convergence mutates binding entries through shallow all_bindings() bypassing lifecycle policy; a narrow facade operation is needed to own mutation while keeping the public shallow query unchanged.
The new note_rich_emit operation must produce identical hash, counter, and persisted bytes as the legacy mutation sequence for changed, unchanged, and missing binding cases.
The operation must perform no per-emit save on any code path, matching the production caller which mutates in place and relies on the pass's unconditional later save.
Missing bindings must remain nonfatal; the operation returns a distinct result (None) to distinguish missing from present entries.
All existing facade signatures and all_bindings shallow copy depth remain unchanged; no production adapter receives direct writable repository or lifecycle objects.
